data.name: Muawidah
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root ‘awwada’, meaning ‘to reunite’ or ‘to bring together’. In Islamic tradition, the name Muawidah is associated with the idea of unity and agreement, symbolizing harmony and understanding between people. It is also a name given to a girl in the Quran, known as Muawidah bint Abi Al-Jahsh, who was a companion of Prophet Muhammad (pbuh).
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes unity and agreement in the Islamic community and personal relationships.

data.spiritual_significance: In the spiritual context, the name Muawidah holds a deep meaning, symbolizing unity and agreement between humans and Allah. It is believed that the name reflects the essence of Tawheed - the belief in the oneness of Allah and the importance of submitting oneself to Him. Moreover, Muawidah is associated with thehadith of the Prophet Muhammad (pbuh) which states, “The strong believer is better and more loved by Allah than the weak believer, and both we and our Lord are pleased with the strong believer.” (Sahih Muslim 1:31), emphasizing the importance of striving for unity and agreement within oneself in order to draw closer to Allah.
